title: MINT: Dynamic-Precision CNN Inference with MSDF Digit-Serial Arithmetic on FPGA
summary: We present MINT, a dynamic-precision CNN inference accelerator based on left-to-right (LR) arithmetic. LR arithmetic computes in most-significant-digit-first manner and exposes useful partial results early so that the computation can be terminated once the desired precision is achieved. At the core, there is a MSDF serial-parallel inner-product unit, which uses redundant signed-digit representation to compute each convolution window.
